bullets: Start a project has 8 more kinds: spreadsheet or budget, document or report, slide deck, online store, event, YouTube or podcast channel, course or training, and game mod.
Ready-made templates for common businesses, such as a bakery website, a realtor listing campaign and a contractor quote sheet. Use one as it is, or Save a copy to make it your own.
Templates can be exported as a file and imported again, for example to share one with a teammate. Files with keys or passwords in them are refused.
The Agents page starts with a short explanation of what agents do and what happens when you use one.
The Live feed can tuck away to the side: press Hide, and a thin tab counts new events until you open it again. Meldmind remembers your choice.
An AI that has been shut down, like Gemini CLI, is removed from Settings and every list instead of showing as off.
A .sql or PowerShell file saved at the end of a job is checked too. If it would not run, the Done card says so instead of saying Done.
Fewer false alarms from the file checks: a query for your own existing database, and every normal way to load the zip parts in PowerShell, now pass.
The Chat row in the sidebar stays lit whatever run mode you pick, and searching for Councils, Missions, Research or Second opinion opens Chat with that mode picked.
heading: More ways to start a project, and agents explained
body: Start a project has 8 more kinds: spreadsheet or budget, document or report, slide deck, online store, event, YouTube or podcast channel, course or training, and game mod. Ready-made templates for common businesses, such as a bakery website, a realtor listing campaign and a contractor quote sheet: use one as it is, or Save a copy to make it your own. Templates can be exported as a file and imported again, for example to share one with a teammate; files with keys or passwords in them are refused. The Agents page starts with a short explanation of what agents do and what happens when you use one. The Live feed can tuck away to the side: press Hide, and a thin tab counts new events until you open it again. Meldmind remembers your choice. An AI that has been shut down, like Gemini CLI, is removed from Settings and every list instead of showing as off. A .sql or PowerShell file saved at the end of a job is checked too. If it would not run, the Done card says so instead of saying Done. Fewer false alarms from the file checks: a query for your own existing database, and every normal way to load the zip parts in PowerShell, now pass. The Chat row in the sidebar stays lit whatever run mode you pick, and searching for Councils, Missions, Research or Second opinion opens Chat with that mode picked.
